ValidationRule.description: AFCA Response Due Date should be mandatory to complete while converting an EDR shell case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(RecordTypeId))), ISPICKVAL(Origin,'11'), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_AFCA_Status__c))), ISNULL(IDR_AFCA_Due_Date__c) )
